translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Mateo

content: A Jesús in exobchal tin cuenta i ts’ejhualixtalab axi chubax
Ca t’aja’ ti cuentachic yab ca t’ojonchi a Dios expith abal quit tsu’tat tit alhua’ c’al a at inic. Max antsana’ ta ca t’aja’, i Tata ti eb yab jant’o ne’ets ti pitha’ i atabilab.

Tam ca ts’ejhualiy an ts’ejhuantalchic c’al jant’o, yab ca t’aja’ ejtil jaja’chic axi tocat in t’ajal eb alhua’q’ui. Ti tiyopan ani ti bel u ts’ejhualix expith abal ca olna ti alhua’. Lej chubax nan tu uchalchic abal c’al nixe’ xi olnomtalab im bats’umalits in atabil.
Axi tata’chic tu c’al nana’ ca tsinat ts’ejhualiy an ts’ejhuantalchic.
Antsana’ yab ne’ets quit tejhua’me c’al a at inic max it ts’ejhualix. Expith i Tata ti eb jats ne’ets ti lej tsu’u ani jats ne’ets ti pitha’ i atabilab.
A Jesús in exobchal cu olon

Tam quit olonchic yab ca t’aja’ ejtil axi eb t’ocatq’ui tu ol. In culbetnal ti ol jun ta ca tsu’tat ti t’ocatac, max ti tiyopan o max ti bel. Lej chubax nan tu uchalchic abal c’al nixe’ in cua’alits in atabil.
Tata’chic tam quit olon quit otsits alta ta q’uima’ ani ca mapuy an hui’leb. Tats ti quit olon c’al i Tata ti eb tsinat. Expith jaja’ ne’ets ti tsu’u ani jaja’ ne’ets ti pitha’ i atabilab.
Tam quit olonchic yab quit alq’uith ulu’in c’al i cau ejtil in t’ajal axi yab exlom c’al a Dios. In q’uibts’oth tsalpayal abal ne’ets ca lej ats’an c’al a Dios tin ebal c’al yantalam i cau.
Yab ca t’aja’ ejtil jaja’chic, cum i Tata ti eb in lej exlalits jant’ots a yejenchal aba ma yabaye a conchamal.
Jaxtam antsana’ ne’ets quit olon:

content.text: I Tata ti eb i c’ac’nanchal a bij.
Quit chich ca t’aja’ tit lej Ts’ale teje’ tsabal.
Quin t’ajchi jaye an inicchic a culbetal teje’ tsabal jant’ini’ tu lej t’ajnal a culbetal tihua’ ti eb.
Tucu pithanchi qui c’apu jant’ots i yejenchal axe’ xa q’uicha.
Tucu paculanchi i hualab cum i paculanchal jitats tucu t’ajchi i hualabtalab.
Tucu lotocna’ abal yab cu c’ale jun ti cu hualbin.
Tata’its expith it lej pulic Ts’ale. A cua’al a lej tsap ani a ts’alat axi ne’ets ca ohuey abal ets’ey. Amén.

content: Max tata’chic ca paculanchi jitats ti t’ajchi i hualabtalab, a Tata ti eb ne’ets ti paculanchi a hualab jaye.
Yab ne’ets ti paculanchi a Tata ti eb, max yab ca paculanchi a at inic.
In exobchal a Jesús tin cuenta am pabiltalab axi chubax

Tata’chic tam it pabil c’al an c’apnel yab ca t’aja’ ejtil axi eb t’ocatq’ui in t’ajal. In t’ajal in hual lej t’e’pith abal ca tsu’tat u pabil. Lej chubax nan tu uchalchic abal c’al nixe’ in cua’alits in atabil.
Tata’chic tam it pabil ca co’oy t’acath a hual ani ch’ichbath a xi’il.
Antsana’ yab ne’ets quit tsu’tat max it pabil. Expith i Tata ti eb jats ne’ets ti tsu’u tit pabil ani jats ne’ets ti pitha’ i atabilab.
An c’alab ti eb
Yab ca tamcuychic yan an c’alab axi teje’ tsabal, cum yab ja ax u ohuel. Hualam ne’ets ti c’apts’unchi tocat an thum. Hualam ne’ets ca cuete’ c’atsey o max ca cue’eyat.
Más alhua’ ca luba’ ca co’oy i c’alab axi tihua’ ti eb. Jats axi yab ne’ets ca c’apts’uhuat c’al an thum. Yab ne’ets ca cuete’ c’atsey ani yab ne’ets ca cue’eyat.
An c’alab axi tata’chic a tsu’talits ley c’athpich huinat alhua’, jats ne’ets ca junini’ tsalapna’ ta ichich.
In ey an tsu’uxtalab
C’al a hual a tsu’talchic an tajax. Max lubach a hual a ejtohual tiquin tajax tsu’u nana’ tin tajax a Dios.
Max yab lubach a hual yab ne’ets tiquin tsu’u. Tiquin co’oy nana’ tin tajax a Dios ta ichich ani iba an yic’uax lej t’ununul.
A Dios ani an tumin

Yab a ejtohual ca co’oy tsab i amulab, cum ne’ets ca c’athpich c’anitha’ axi jun ani axi jun iba. Ne’ets ca putu c’al in uchbixtal c’al axi jun ani c’al axi jun iba. Ni abal jay yab a ejtohual ca c’anitha’ a Dios ani jaye ca t’ajat c’anitha’ an tumin.
U beletnom a Dios c’al in tsacamilchic

Nan tu uchalchic yab quit xe’tsin tsalpopol c’al an c’apnel, ani c’al an uts’nel, ani c’al an toltom. In exbath a ejattal lej c’athpich yab ejtil in exbath an c’apnel, ani in exbath a inictal lej c’athpich yab ejtil in exbath an toltom.

Ca t’aja’chic ti cuenta an ts’itsinchic abal yab u om, ani yab u c’ojol, ani yab in thayal jant’o ti al an huilte’. Bel u c’apulchic, cum expith c’al i Tata ti eb u pijchab. A exbath tata’chic lej c’athpich yab ejtil in exbath an ts’itsin.
Aba ma ca lej xijc’ath luba’ ta ba’ quit t’ec’atme ts’ejel metro, ni abal jay yab ne’ets ca ejtou.

Yab in tomnal quit xe’tsinchic tsalpopol c’al an toltom. Ca t’aja’chic ti cuenta jant’ini’ tu puhuel an huits. Yab ja tin ebal abal u t’ojnal, ani yab tin ebal max u huichalac abal quin ts’ejca’ tim ba’.
Nan tu uchalchic abal an ts’ale Salomón c’al patal in ts’alat toltomil yab im baju in alabental ejtil an huits.

C’al a Dios jats tu ts’ejcanal an huits c’athpich alabel. Ti jun a q’uicha ejate, ani ti jun a q’uicha tsemenequits ani ca chican. Cum más a exbathchic c’al a Dios, más ne’ets ti t’ajchi. Tata’chic ojni’ yabaye a alhua’ belamalchic a Dios.
Yabats quit xe’tsin tsalpopol ani cononol ta ichich c’al an c’apnel, ani c’al an uts’nel, ani c’al an toltom.
Axi yab u exlom c’al a Dios jats axi xe’ets tsalpopol c’al jahua’ teje’ tsabal. Tata’chic yab antsana’ ta ca t’aja’, cum a cua’al a Tata ti eb ax in tso’obits patal jahua’ a yejenchal.
Expith ca junini’ jilchichic a Dios quin t’aja’ ti Ts’ale ta ichich ani ca junini’ t’aja’ bolith jant’ini’ jaja’ tin le’, ani tamna’ jaja’ ne’ets ti pitha’chic patal jahua’ ca yejenchi teje’ tsabal.

Jaxtam yabats quit xe’tsinchic tsalpopol jant’oye ta ca huat’a’ calam. Tam ca chutheyits, tam ne’ets ca yejenchi ca lej t’aja’ ti cuenta jant’o ta ca huat’a’. Ta q’uicha ta q’uicha bijithits jant’o qui yajchicna’.
